_doc: M&S env roots: what each env exists to run (lib/env_roots.py reads it; report only). Copy to $KREW_HOME/ms-env-roots.json (krew-install.py seeds this empty one) or point ms.yaml roots_file at yours. envs: {name: {label, units, files (the app's requirement files), app (its dists), entries (scripts / package dirs its units run, import-scanned), entries_wide, entry_point_groups, file_roots, data_wheels, clis, conda, orphan_remove}}. defaults apply to every env. Empty envs = every env reports 'no roots declared'. The reference install's rows are machine data (its paths and units) and are not shipped; `_reference_install` lists only its env names and the row keys it uses.

_reference_install._doc: The machine krew was built on: its roots rows verbatim (regenerated 2026-10-10 from its config/ms-env-roots.json), with ${MS_ENVS_ROOT} / {data} / ~/projects placeholders and its own unit prefix written ref-. Copy a row into `envs` when that env exists on your machine.

rebuild._doc: Stage D (lib/env_rebuild.py): built beside the old env from these roots, checked off-GPU, re-rendered in a Render window, flipped by symlink.
rebuild._serve_note: serve_args [] = how ordinary Render runs Comfy BESIDE crew + Cosy (~43 GiB free): --highvram cannot fit there (5 of 14 ran out of memory on 09-29). High-VRAM is WANTED (the owner 09-29: 'we DO want high vram. That is the whole point'); it belongs to the heavy-render mode, which takes crew off the card first.

file_roots.by: rail-stt.service LD_LIBRARY_PATH (faster-whisper / ctranslate2 load cuBLAS, cuDNN, NVRTC by path)

vllm.label: the reference interpreter (wall, conductors, presence, doctors; named vllm, runs no vLLM server)
vllm.scan_note: narrow = the units' entry scripts and what they import; wide = every app script and lib module, the conservative bound (scripts spawned with sys.executable)

vllm-0271-cu132.label: crew / Beast vLLM 0.27.1 (vllm-ref-env.sh); ops left for vllm-030-cu132 on 09-30

rebuild._doc: Stage D for the vLLM lanes is NOT complete (09-30): the plan step still names vllm with no version and carries the old nvidia-cutlass-dsl as a constraint, so it cannot select a new engine. What is here is what the 09-30 hand build of vllm-030-cu132 needed and a rebuild must not forget.

patches.why: torchaudio 2.11.0 is a cu130 build (no +cu132 wheel exists) and refuses to import beside torch 2.13.0+cu132; transformers imports it (loss_rnnt), so vllm cannot start. _check_cuda_version returns None on its first line. Drop this entry when a +cu132 torchaudio is installed.

first_start._doc: The owner 09-30: a new env's first start happens outside the lane. ops's own model from the new env in a transient unit; FlashInfer builds its NVFP4 kernels once here (fp4_gemm_cutlass_sm120), bounded by MAX_JOBS - unbounded it took 76 GB on 32 cores. ops is held + stopped for those minutes and started again by the unit's stop hook.
